changes.title: Brand skins can have a quiet backdrop texture from your own world (a stone wall, timber, a soft sky)
One brand, more than one surface: skin variants, each in the Skin button
Contrast rule: panels never the same colour as the ground, unless you ask
The sample hub shows a neutral business; skin previews use your own business
Mentor lessons inside the hub: a drawing of each idea, one question at a time, layers ticked
Your path laid out in modules, three layers per topic
Any chat can suggest a better way to work; one click adds it to Recos
Clients, posts, topics and months open their page in the hub
Council in depth: Mentor SWOT read, Board meetings and deep dives with a Chair, Front Desk top three and pace call (OS 7b)
Without hub chats switched on, lessons and chats open in Claude instead
The autopilot rule: every automation is set and forget; when it needs you, it does 99% of the prep, says the one thing to do and waits for your go
